item.title: Breeze Airways Expands Internationally from New Orleans, Adds New Service to Cancun, Mexico - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Breeze Airways announced an international network expansion from New Orleans (MSY) with nonstop flights to Cancun, Mexico. The new seasonal service is scheduled to begin February 7, 2026, pending final government approvals.

item.title: New Orleans Airport Issues Call for Local Musicians - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: The Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport issued a call for musicians interested in performing at the Airport as part of its live entertainment program for 2026. Interested local musicians are invited to apply before Wednesday, October 22, 2025.

item.title: Frontier Airlines Adds Routes and Increases Service Frequency to Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport for Mardi Gras Celebrations - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Let the good times roll! Frontier Airlines is making travel to New Orleans for Mardi Gras more convenient and affordable by adding 12 new routes and increasing service frequency on existing routes during the month of February 2026.

item.title: Allegiant Begins Nonstop Service from New Orleans to Punta Gorda, Flordia with One-Way Fares as Low as $41* - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Allegiant today begins service from Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY) to Punta Gorda Airport (PGD) in Florida.

item.title: Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport's Music Program Wins National Award for Best Customer Experience - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: The City of New Orleans, the New Orleans Aviation Board and other local, state and federal partners hosted a groundbreaking ceremony at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport to mark the start of construction of the $84.5 million Express Shuttle Connector Road Project, which is a dedicated shuttle roadway connecting the Economy Garage, Employee Garage and Rental Car Center on the Airport’s south campus to the terminal on the north campus.

item.title: Louis Armstrong Airport Celebrates The Club MSY Lounge Renovation - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: On Wednesday, Feb. 4, the Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY) and its concessions partner, Airport Dimensions, unveiled the newly renovated The Club MSY lounge, featuring updates that reimagine the space as a curated retreat blending New Orleans' heritage with contemporary design.

item.title: Louis Armstrong Airport Named Best Airport in North America Five Years in a Row - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: For the fifth year in a row, the Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY) received a top customer experience award for Best Airport at Departures in North America (5 to 15 million passengers per year) from the Airports Council International (ACI) World’s 2025 Airport Service Quality (ASQ) program. The ASQ awards highlight the world’s best airports as judged by their customers who are surveyed while they are in the airport.

item.title: Louis Armstrong Airport to Begin Work on $27.1 Million Runway Rehabilitation Project - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Construction is set to begin on the Runway 2/20 Keel Rehabilitation & Buildout Project at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY). The approximately $27.1 million project, funded primarily through the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Airport Improvement Program (AIP), will rehabilitate critical portions of one of the airport’s two runways to ensure long-term safety, reliability, and operational efficiency.

item.title: Mayor Moreno, Regional Leaders Share Details of Master Plan for Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Today, Mayor Helena Moreno and the New Orleans Aviation Board (NOAB) joined the Parish Presidents from the parishes in the Greater New Orleans Region, Greater New Orleans, Inc., and New Orleans & Co. to discuss Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport’s Master Plan, which outlines the strategic vision for its long-term growth.

item.title: New Orleans Airport Provides Update on TSA Checkpoint Lines - Louis Armstrong New Orleans Airport
item.description: Due to impacts from the federal government's partial shutdown, there continues to be a shortage of Transportation Security Administration (TSA) workers at the security checkpoint at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY).
